modules.title: Circulation
modules.description: Lend and return items, review loans and manage requests. Start here when working at the circulation desk.
tips: Check the patron before lending.
Read the due date and any hold or transfer instructions.

modules.title: Patrons
modules.description: Find and maintain the people registered with your library. Patron records connect membership, contact details and borrowing activity.
tips: Check for an existing record before adding a person.
Category and library affect the rules applied to a patron.

modules.title: Advanced search
modules.description: Build a catalog search with more criteria and limits than a basic search. Use it to narrow down bibliographic results.
tips: Choose useful search terms and available limits.
Open a result to inspect its description and copies.

modules.title: Item search
modules.description: Search physical copies rather than just bibliographic descriptions. This helps identify items by their local details.
tips: Distinguish a record describing a title from an individual copy.
The item-search form has its own filters; the linked guide explains general catalog results, not that complete form.

modules.title: Lists
modules.description: Collect bibliographic records into named lists, for example a reading list or a selection for an activity.
tips: Review list visibility and editing permissions.
Adding a record to a list does not create another copy.

modules.title: Course reserves
modules.description: Organize courses and the resources reserved for teaching, when this feature is enabled.
tips: Course information and reserve items are separate parts of the workflow.
Departments and other local settings may need preparation.

modules.title: Authorities
modules.description: Search and maintain the controlled names, organizations, titles and subjects used in cataloging.
tips: Inspect identifiers and variants before selecting a heading.
Matching names alone do not prove that two authorities represent the same entity.

modules.title: Interlibrary loans
modules.description: Manage requests for materials from other libraries through the configured ILL provider.
tips: Available actions depend on the provider and current request status.
Review costs, supplier details and patron information before confirming actions.

modules.title: E-resource management
modules.description: Open Koha’s electronic resource management area when enabled. The module handles electronic-resource workflows such as agreements and licenses.
tips: Availability depends on configuration and permissions.
This edition explains the entry point; detailed ERM screens are not yet reproduced.

modules.title: Point of sale
modules.description: Record payments for configured items or services using the enabled cash-register workflow.
tips: Check amount, tendered payment and cash register before confirming.
This edition does not simulate taking payments or issuing receipts.

modules.title: Cataloging
modules.description: Create and edit bibliographic records and their items. This is where the description of a resource and its physical copies are maintained.
tips: Select the correct framework and complete required fields.
Review duplicate warnings and distinguish titles from copies.

modules.title: Serials
modules.description: Manage serial subscriptions and the receiving of issues, using configured publication and numbering patterns.
tips: A subscription links to a bibliographic record.
Check frequency and numbering carefully before relying on predicted issues.

modules.title: Acquisitions
modules.description: Manage purchasing through vendors, budgets, baskets, orders and receiving.
tips: Review funds, currencies and supplier details.
Finding a vendor is not the same as placing or receiving an order.

modules.title: Reports
modules.description: Find, build and run reports to answer questions about the library’s data, subject to your permissions.
tips: Read the report purpose and parameters before running it.
Protect personal data when exporting or sharing results.

modules.title: Preservation
modules.description: Open the preservation module when enabled to manage preservation workflows.
tips: Its screens and workflow depend on local configuration.
This edition identifies the module but does not simulate preservation processing.

modules.title: Tools
modules.description: Open specialized and batch tools, including inventory and MARC staging. Some operations can change many records at once.
tips: Read the scope and options before starting a batch job.
Test a small selection and keep a recovery path for changes.

modules.title: Administration
modules.description: Configure how the library operates: preferences, libraries, categories, item types, rules and other settings.
tips: Changes can affect staff and public workflows throughout the installation.
Review existing settings and permissions before changing them.
